editorial: Forget everything you know about corporate zombies and laser hallways. You are dropped into a claustrophobic nightmare where the horror feels visceral, tactile, and terrifyingly intimate. Zach Cregger strips away the franchise bloat to deliver a lean, mean survivalist gauntlet that prioritizes dread over jump scares. It is a relentless exercise in tension that makes you feel every desperate breath Bryan takes. If you crave a return to pure, unfiltered biological terror, this is your new obsession.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of stripped-back survival horror and psychological tension.
